In West Bank, ambulance drivers say Israeli checkpoints are dangerous obstacles to work To reach hospitals in the occupied West Bank, Palestinian ambulance drivers navigate Israeli checkpoints and road closures. Rights groups say wait times have spiked and medics have been attacked.
